title: Pay attention. It's just the cover
text: Pay attention. It's just the cover. My daughter had been given a different sequin pillow as a gift and we both had fun playing with it. We bought this one as a gift for a friend and we couldn't give it. The sequins didn't really make the designs well. (Some were just stiff than others and stuck until brushed a lot).  Also, it didn't come stuffed but that was my fault for not reading the description better. We stuffed it and tried it out and we were a bit disappointed. The purple and silver were cute together.
